description: County Health Rankings & Roadmaps is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by University of Wisconsin-Madison | Population Health Institute. For decades, people have measured conditions that influence how well and how long we live, from access to affordable housing, to jobs that pay a living wage and opportunities for a good education. Access data for your own county, or compare statistics across several counties. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Air Quality, Flooding – General, Vector-Borne Disease, Water Quality. Assets: People. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
